subject: Logic
title: The Power of What If
description: A fast breakdown of The Power of What If for builders.

hook.text: What if you could read minds? Fun question—but also a rigorous way to explore privacy, consent, and identity.

buildup.text: What if is the engine of thought experiments. It gives permission to explore without commitment.

discovery.text: Children do this naturally—but adults stop because it feels unserious. Philosophy says it's deeply serious.

twist.text: Every scientific revolution began with what if. What if the Earth moves? What if space is curved?

climax.text: The question isn't whether a scenario is real. It's what the scenario forces you to think through.

punchline.text: What if is the most powerful question in logic.

quiz.question: Why is 'what if' powerful in reasoning?
options: It forces exploration of consequences without commitment
